summary: On signup, adopt the guest query row in place (set user_id/session_id) and land the user mid-research
description: Depends on the CTA + guest migration. Carry the signed guest token through Clerk signup. After signup completes: create a real sessions row for the new user (snapshot free-tier voice per BRD-chat-voice §5), then UPDATE queries SET user_id=<new user>, session_id=<new session>, tier_used='free', guest_ip=NULL WHERE guest_token_hash= AND user_id IS NULL — a single in-place adoption, no copy, no second table, PII (IP) shed on conversion. Redirect to /chat/<sessionId> so they resume mid-research. Guard against double-adopt on refresh (the WHERE user_id IS NULL makes it idempotent). Include a test asserting the row's user_id/session_id are set and guest_ip cleared.
